rows.effects: Reads installed skills via runtime skills.discover; no publish
rows.output: JSON preserves RPC success envelope (id,ok,result:{skills:[{id,name,description,providers,sourceKind,sourceLabel}]},_meta); text lists summaries or 'No installed skills found.'

rows.dryRun: Not supported; no preview branch. Publication is attempted only after argument/host/preflight guards, and may fail.
rows.effects: Requests publication of explicit discovered skills to an unlisted link; source spec says anyone holding the link can inspect/install. Runtime gates before preparation and publication, guards concurrent publication and uses a preparation service; deep service internals not audited here. No cloud destination is authorized for reuse.
rows.output: JSON preserves RPC success envelope with result:{url,shareId,packageId,versionId,bundleName,skills}; text pluralizes 'Shared N skill(s): <url>'.
rows.preconditions: Forwarded refusal on ORCA_CLI_CWD or client.isRemote before arguments; CLI settings.get preflight blocks only explicit false, skips on error/missing value; runtime publishing requires explicit true and rechecks before publication. 600000ms skills.share timeout.
rows.bundleNormalization: NFKD; remove combining marks U+0300–036F; en-US lowercase; replace non [a-z0-9.-] runs by hyphen; collapse two or more hyphens/dots; trim edge hyphens/dots; truncate64 then trim trailing hyphens/dots; reject empty.

defaults.full: Absent => false; handler uses flags.has('full'), not a value comparison.

errors: invalid_argument with topic list on unknown/missing topic

rows.effects: Executes argv ['--yes','skills','add','https://github.com/stablyai/orca',...skillNames.flatMap(name=>['--skill',name]),...(global?['--global']:[]),...agents.flatMap(agent=>['--agent',agent]),'-y'] with resolved npx. Inherited child stdio; status stderr; numeric exit forwarded, signal exit=>1, null/no-signal=>0. Actual downloader/placement behavior belongs external skills CLI and is not verified by this audit.
rows.output: No selection: names list ({availableSkills} or help text)
rows.preconditions: No runtime client involved in handler; no selection lists all bundled names and returns before host/agent checks (not a scan of installed skills). With selection ORCA_CLI_CWD alone triggers refusal, including dry-run; this handler does not check client.isRemote. Explicit agent CSV avoids detection; otherwise detect on execution host. Dry-run resolves agents first; no child spawn.

rows.effects: Executes npx argv ['--yes','skills','update',...selectedNames,global?'--global':'--project','-y']; never supplies --agent or performs agent detection. Delegates refresh behavior to external skills CLI; no local installed-placement validation is performed by this handler.
errors: Same selection, ORCA_CLI_CWD forwarding, real-run JSON, and npx launch rules as install; no missing-agent validation.
rows.output: No selection: {availableSkills:allCanonicalBundledNames} or selection help. Dry-run: {command,skills,global,executed:false} or text. Real run rejects --json and streams child output.
rows.preconditions: Same selection/ORCA_CLI_CWD guard as install; no-selection returns all canonical bundled names, not actual installed/updatable results. No agent prerequisite.
